statements.t: • Announced a plan to separate the Company’s Integrated Upstream and Gathering business ("IUG") into a standalone publicly traded company which is expected to be named Seneca Resources, with the transaction anticipated to occur in the second half of calendar 2027.
The long-term outlook for each of our businesses is strong.

With the closing of our Ohio gas utility acquisition and our announced plan to separate our Integrated Upstream and Gathering business, we are well positioned to establish two scaled, financially sound publicly traded natural gas businesses.
Against a strong long-term outlook for natural gas demand, we believe both businesses are exceptionally well positioned for continued success."
The Company is initiating guidance for fiscal 2027.
Accordingly, the Company's fiscal 2027 guidance includes the expected results of IUG for the full fiscal year.
The Company is initiating adjusted earnings per share guidance for fiscal 2027 with a range of $6.00 to $6.40.
Given the continued volatility in NYMEX natural gas prices, the Company is providing the following sensitivities to its adjusted earnings per share guidance:

• Utility segment earnings are expected to increase as a result of the Ohio gas utility acquisition, the continuation of our multi-year New York rate case settlement, and the recently approved base rate increase in Pennsylvania.

• Combined Utility and Pipeline & Storage segment capital expenditures are expected to range between $490 and $580 million, driven by continued investment in our longstanding modernization programs, as well as the addition of the Ohio natural gas utility.
Additional details on the Company's updated forecast assumptions and business segment guidance for fiscal 2027 are outlined in the table on page 8.
As discussed on page 2, the Company is initiating preliminary adjusted earnings per share guidance for fiscal 2027.

While the Company expects to record certain adjustments to unrealized gain or loss on investments during the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027, the amounts of these and other potential adjustments are not reasonably determinable at this time.
As such, the Company is unable to provide earnings guidance other than on a non-GAAP basis.
The Company is unable to provide a reconciliation of any projected free cash flow measure to its comparable GAAP financial measure without unreasonable efforts.

risks.t: the ability to obtain any consents or approvals required to complete the Separation
the ability of the separated companies to each succeed as standalone publicly traded companies
negative effects of the announcement or pendency of the Separation on the market price of the Company’s securities and/or on the Company’s financial performance
the possibility that the Separation will not achieve its intended benefits
the possibility of disruption, including disputes, litigation, or unanticipated costs in connection with the Separation
the impact of the Separation on the Company’s businesses and the risk that the Separation may be more
